Main.tscn.responsibility: vertical slice composition only; no gameplay authority

notes: Mouse click commands remain authoritative through bridge.
No body-balance mechanic.
Movement must not snag on micro-relief.
Dialogue does not freeze NPC or player.
Name visible on hover only.
Combat result comes from Stage03/07 authority.
Enemy bar stays screen-aligned and straight.
Physics only until settling, then freeze/sleep.
Pickup authoritative only at <=0.5m.
Inventory full leaves drop active.
Icon is category-based, not unique item art.
Tree/rock/ore/flora/agriculture/hunt/fish outputs use Ground Loot channel.
Visual, collision and traversal surfaces remain conceptually separated.
No free orbit in first slice.
Occluder fade before abrupt camera shortening.
Camera feedback cannot change resolved click target.
World-first contextual HUD; no permanent large panels.
Weapon quick slots show exactly two loadout slots and fade back to discreet after swap.
Stamina is not a fixed HUD bar; it uses StaminaWorldRing.tscn adjacent to player.
White rounded bubble.
Normal text medium gray.
Important text soft light orange.
Screen-space UI follows player world projection without rotating with player.
Soft yellow radial fill depletes/replenishes with authoritative stamina.
Completely hidden at 100% when not being consumed/regenerated.
Same white rounded visual language as dialogue bubble.
Rounded legible typography; light/medium gray text with sufficient contrast.
Inventory may contain many weapons; only two quick-loadout weapon slots are active-ready.
Carries non-authoritative depth/flow sampling metadata for bridge requests.
Shallow under-bridge water is not blocked merely because a bridge exists.
No body-balance/ragdoll current mechanic in this stage.
Bag is one physical container; contents remain backend authoritative.
Water bag floats and exposes a 30-minute recoverable timer.
Land bag has no expiry.
Foreign NPC bag recovery preserves property owner context.
